reasons.action: The brief explicitly requests a new temporal motion—the car pulling forward—overriding the storyboard's static pose.
reasons.medium: The medium decision preserves the live-action reference; the motion request does not request a rendering-medium change.
reasons.wardrobe: No clothing or accessory change is requested; the car's observed carbon-fibre body appearance remains reference-governed.
reasons.lighting: “Out of the dark” explicitly establishes a dark visible light condition for the car's emergence, so the request governs lighting.
reasons.framing: No camera composition, shot scale, viewpoint or movement is specified; pulling forward alone does not set framing, so the reference governs.
reasons.palette: No scene color palette is requested; “dark” is treated as a lighting condition rather than a palette replacement, so the reference palette governs.
